description: Search the narrowboats, motor boats, sailing boats, RIBs, kayaks, canoes, paddleboards and jet skis for sale on Boatsite now, advertised by their UK owners. Filters: section, make, model, place, price, year, length, berths, engine type, fuel, hull material, engine hours, an included trailer or mooring, and an in-date Boat Safety Scheme certificate. Returns up to 10 adverts, newest first, each with its price, place and advert link. Use get_listing_detail with an advert's slug and listingId for the full advert.

bssInDate.description: Only boats whose Boat Safety Scheme certificate is in date.

category.description: Section: Narrowboats, Motor boats, Sailing boats, RIBs, Kayaks, Canoes, Paddleboards, Jet skis.

city.description: Town or city the advert is in.

kind.description: A kind within the section, from list_categories (for example sit-on-top for kayaks, widebeam for narrowboats). Needs category.

limit.description: How many adverts to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

make.description: Maker, as the seller gave it.

model.description: Model, as the seller gave it.

mooringIncluded.description: Only adverts that include a mooring.

q.description: Words to find in the advert title, make or model.

trailerIncluded.description: Only adverts that include a trailer.

name: search_boats
title: Search Boatsite
